Michael Schumacher appears in four of the documents, all driving for Ferrari: the 2000 United States Grand Prix [1], the 2000 Spanish Grand Prix [3], the 2000 Belgian Grand Prix [4], and the 2000 German Grand Prix [5]. Document [2] lists Mick Schumacher (Haas), a different driver, so it doesn't count. The documents only show top-10 finishers, so this covers only the races where he finished in the top 10.

ANSWER: 1
